purpose: Review criteria for UX/UI documents: lists the SSOT documents to check by priority, with provisional fallbacks, the order of checks, and the rules for deciding recommendations.
summary: Delegates norms and severity to principles; this file holds no judgment itself
Notes that dedicated UX/UI principles are not yet available and a fallback is used
SSOT reference table: Apple HIG, project design system rules, document style guide
P1 order: Apple HIG, project rules (skipped if absent), style guide fallback
Targets include THEME, CMP, SCR, UXEVAL and UI design inside design docs
P2 contradiction checks on tokens, components, screens and interactions
P3 unnecessary complexity check against spec priorities, answered Yes/No
tasks: Reviewing UI design sections inside a design document
Checking compliance with Apple HIG in a review
Deciding fix, create_issue or skip for a UX/UI review finding
Checking contradictions between UI specs and requirements or design
title: uxui レビュー基準
